name: briefcase-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Briefcase, the BeeWare tool that turns a Python project into a standalone native
application. This task covers its project configuration (the `[tool.briefcase]` settings in `pyproject.toml`), its
command-line commands and their options, the environment managers it uses to install requirements, and its Linux
(system packages, AppImage, Flatpak) and Web (static site) platform backends.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the briefcase package: src/briefcase/__init__.py, __main__.py, cmdline.py, config.py, console.py, constants.py and exceptions.py; every module in src/briefcase/commands/; src/briefcase/platforms/__init__.py; every module in src/briefcase/platforms/linux/ and src/briefcase/platforms/web/; src/briefcase/integrations/file.py; and every module in src/briefcase/integrations/virtual_environment/. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/en/reference/index.md, docs/en/reference/configuration.md, docs/en/reference/environment.md, every page in docs/en/reference/commands/, docs/en/reference/platforms/index.md, every page in docs/en/reference/platforms/linux/, docs/en/reference/platforms/web/static.md, every page in docs/en/reference/env_management/, docs/en/how-to/building/cli-apps.md, docs/en/how-to/building/external-apps.md and docs/en/topics/access-packaging-metadata.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Whe
